text: Eithne the Fair was a human woman so charming that Finnbheara, king of the Munster fairies, took notice. He cast a spell that sent her into a deep sleep. By night she walked the Otherworld, a land so lovely that she found the waking world ugly. She escaped her husband and reached Finnbheara's fairy mound at Knockma in County Galway. Her husband dug in, threw salt, and pulled her out. He removed a tiny fairy pin, and Eithne woke believing one night had passed. A year had passed.
